name: Chemtrails
claim: Persistent aircraft contrails are chemicals deliberately sprayed for weather control, population control, or other purposes.
description: Contrail persistence depends on humidity and temperature at altitude — a phenomenon documented since the 1940s. A 2016 survey of 77 atmospheric scientists found none who had encountered evidence of a spraying program. Real geoengineering research (stratospheric aerosols) is discussed openly in scientific literature, which the theory conflates with covert operations.

name: Philadelphia Experiment
claim: In 1943 the US Navy rendered the USS Eldridge invisible and teleported it, with horrific effects on the crew.
description: Originated in letters from Carl Allen ('Carlos Allende') to a UFO author; Allen later admitted invention. Ship's logs place the Eldridge elsewhere on the claimed dates. Likely garbled from real degaussing research (making ships undetectable to magnetic mines, not eyes).

name: HAARP Weather-Control Theories
claim: The HAARP ionospheric research array causes earthquakes, hurricanes, or mind control.
description: HAARP's 3.6 MW heats a small patch of ionosphere to study radio propagation — energy many orders of magnitude below weather systems, and physically incapable of coupling to tectonics. The facility, now run by the University of Alaska, holds open houses. A staple attribution after any natural disaster.

name: Dead Internet Theory
claim: Most internet content and activity is now generated by bots and AI rather than people, curated to manipulate perception.
description: The strong claim (a coordinated takeover dating to ~2016) is unevidenced; the weak claim tracks real measurements — bot traffic rivaling human traffic, synthetic content proliferating post-2022. Interesting as a theory whose plausibility rose after its invention due to generative AI.

name: Project Blue Beam
claim: NASA will fake an alien invasion or second coming with holograms to impose a world government.
description: Advanced by journalist Serge Monast without documentation. Perpetually predicted, never occurring; each new sky phenomenon (drone swarms, satellite trains) is folded into it. The archetype of prophecy-style technological conspiracy.
